thread:
Marie (CS): Hey team — quick onboarding ask for HelixHealth. They're mid-migration and hit a throttling wall when seeding the APAC edge. Can we do a controlled egress bandwidth bump for 48h to finish the migration? Renewal conversation in ~3 weeks, this demo is high-impact.

Raj (Edge Ops): How much bandwidth are they requesting and which CIDRs/IPs will be used? Any contract/exemptions needed?

Marie (CS): Requesting a temporary increase to 200Mbps for ap-southeast-1, IP is 203.0.113.45/32. Customer account: helixhealth-prod. We'll need auto-revoke after 48h and a short audit log entry. No PII will be transferred, this is bulk model weights and embeddings.

Dylan (Network): Confirmed that peering to ap-southeast-1 is healthy from our side. Need to ensure upstream carrier quotas won't spike costs — will estimate cost delta.

Olga (Platform): Can we apply a scoped policy so only that IP and model-serving route get the bump? Prefer not to expand token/QPS limits. Also set fallback to eu-west-1 if edge errors increase.

Marie (CS): Yes — scoped to model-serving route /v1/generate and only that IP. Fallback to eu-west-1 is acceptable if health checks fail.

Raj (Edge Ops): I'll draft the change. Proposed config snippet:

```
# temp-egress policy
target: ap-southeast-1
route: /v1/generate
egress_bandwidth: 200Mbps
allowlist:
  - 203.0.113.45/32
duration: 48h
auto_revoke: true
fallback_regions:
  - eu-west-1
note: "HelixHealth migration window; renew in ~3w"
```

Raj (Edge Ops): Need an approver on billing for transient cost. @Dylan, can you sign off on carrier/peering cost impact?

Dylan (Network): I'll run a quick estimate — looks like ~+$60 for 48h at projected throughput. Fine to proceed if CS ok.

Marie (CS): Customer has sign-off on cost. Please proceed and tag me when live so I can confirm with them.

Olga (Platform): Two operational notes: 1) We'll enable request-level logging for that route for the 48h window, 2) We'll create a rollback monitor to auto-failover back to eu-west-1 on error rate > 3% sustained for 5m.

sre-bot: Created ticket CS-48291: "HelixHealth ap-southeast-1 temporary egress bump (48h)" assigned to @raj_edgeops. Audit log entry queued.

Raj (Edge Ops): Change scheduled in 15m. Will post deploy hash and trace id once active.

Marie (CS): Awesome — thanks everyone. Please ensure auto-revoke triggers and add a short renewal note to the account so AE sees impact during renewal call. :thumbsup:
